apworld_description: Send-only Manual for Super Mario Galaxy 2 (Wii / Nintendo Switch).
Every galaxy you unlock and every Power Star (optionally Green Stars) you collect is a check that sends an item to another player.
You never receive any real item: nothing in Galaxy 2 is locked, so you simply play the game normally.

tutorials.description: How to set up and play the send-only Super Mario Galaxy 2 Manual.
